entries.title: Every computer on your iPhone keeps sending notifications
entries.body: Each computer your iPhone or iPad keeps now goes on sending notifications while you show another one, instead of stopping after a few days. Your phone leaves each computer a sealed note through Infinitary's relay whenever its notification permission renews, which only that computer can read. When you forget a computer, its note tells it to stop sending within a day, even while it is out of reach.
entries.noPicture: The phone and the computer pass these notes in the background; no view changes.
